title: One Sentence Saved Him From a Crocodile #shorts

cast.croc: a big green cartoon crocodile with a long bumpy snout, small yellow eyes and white pointy teeth
cast.mom: a stick-figure mother with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs and a long brown cloak
cast.boy: a small stick-figure boy with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs and a tan tunic

lines.text: What one sentence could save a boy from a hungry crocodile?
lines.label: ONE SENTENCE
lines.headline: THE CROCODILE PARADOX
lines.image: {croc} standing waist-deep in a river, its huge jaws wide open right above {boy}, who it holds in one claw, while {mom} stands frozen in shock on the sandy riverbank, dramatic stormy sky

lines.text: A crocodile snatched a little boy, then offered his mother a deal.
lines.label: THE RIVER
lines.headline: SNATCHED FROM THE SHORE
lines.image: {croc} in the shallow river holding {boy} in one claw and pointing at {mom} with the other, {mom} on the sandy riverbank with both hands on her head in panic

lines.text: "Guess what I'll do next, and your son goes free."
lines.label: THE DEAL
lines.headline: GUESS RIGHT, HE GOES FREE
lines.image: close-up of {croc} grinning slyly with one claw raised like making a promise, {boy} held in its other arm, a calm river behind

lines.text: "But guess wrong," it hissed, "and I eat him."
lines.label: THE CATCH
lines.headline: GUESS WRONG, HE'S DINNER
lines.image: {croc} licking its lips and holding {boy} right next to its open jaws full of pointy teeth, {boy} looking terrified

lines.text: She looked it in the eye and said, "You will eat my son."
lines.label: HER ANSWER
lines.headline: YOU WILL EAT MY SON
lines.image: {mom} standing tall and calm on the riverbank, pointing one finger straight at {croc}, who holds {boy} in the river and looks surprised

lines.text: If it eats him, her guess was right, so it broke its promise.
lines.label: OPTION ONE
lines.headline: IF IT EATS HIM
lines.image: {croc} lifting {boy} toward its open jaws, then freezing with a worried frown, {mom} watching from the riverbank

lines.text: If it lets him go, her guess was wrong, so it should eat him.
lines.label: OPTION TWO
lines.headline: IF IT LETS HIM GO
lines.image: {croc} setting {boy} down on the sand near {mom}, then pausing with a confused frown, one claw still reaching for {boy}

lines.text: Either way it breaks its own deal, so the crocodile froze, totally stuck.
lines.label: THE TRAP
lines.headline: NO MOVE LEFT
lines.image: {croc} sitting frozen in the river scratching its head with one claw, eyes spinning in dizzy confusion, holding {boy} loosely, {mom} watching closely from the riverbank

lines.text: While it froze, she grabbed her son and ran, saved by one clever sentence.
lines.label: SHE WINS
lines.headline: ONE SENTENCE SAVED HIM
lines.image: {mom} running across the sandy riverbank carrying {boy} in her arms, both smiling, while {croc} sits frozen in the river behind them, puzzled, warm golden sunset light
